job.purpose: HH-7 10-19: parent hv16_dbk_cpl-q1-65c2387ab NEEDS_RTL TT -12.3 (routed sign-off, 4 endpoints): u_control/bank_read_addr[166] -> L[5].read_addr[6] -12.30 (S-face pin, bank in the NW corner: ~457 um U-turn around the controller) and u_control/bank_write_slot[6] -> L[2].write_slot[6] -11.73 (one W-face 7-bit broadcast star to all 8 banks; the SE bank leg ~360 um). The controller faces were planned for the old NE-corner parent; in the 4x3 parent the controller sits in col1 rows 1-2. Fix: bank_read_addr and both slot broadcasts split per bank group onto the face toward it (S banks 0-2, W banks 3-4, N banks 5-7), point-to-point copies of the same registers (0 cycles, exact). Worst parent leg 457 -> ~343 um (maze estimate). Benches unchanged (lockstep vs cursor + 4-stack production + mutants + reset/fault + wb_ready).
